name: astra-runtime-manager
description: Check Codex CLI compatibility, report token usage, and manage tested experimental Astra runtimes.

interface.shortDescription: Check compatibility, measure usage, and manage tested runtimes.
interface.longDescription: Community tools for CLI capability checks and private usage comparisons. Runtime activation requires a tested release and platform; installing the plugin alone does not enable the patch. Savings remain unmeasured.
defaultPrompt: Check my CLI compatibility and Astra runtime status.
Compare my before and after token usage.
Set up and enable the supported Astra runtime.
